articles.title: Tennessee's prison chief resigns after botched execution of murderer Christa Pike
articles.summary: Prison commissioner Frank Strada insisted his team followed protocol, even after two doses of anesthetic failed to kill convicted murderer Christa Pike. He is set to leave his post this month.

articles.title: High mortgage rates are trapping homeowners in place, and making renovations harder to afford
articles.summary: Homeowners are stuck in houses they might have left by now due to the low mortgage rates of the past, and can't even remodel with HELOCs too expensive to tap.

articles.title: Ukraine to step up oil attacks as Russia hits Kyiv bridges
articles.summary: As Moscow intensifies attacks on Kyiv and other cities, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has vowed to hit Russian energy infrastructure.

articles.title: Greens would offer two-year jobs to unemployed under-24s
articles.summary: Co-deputy leader Mothin Ali tells the party's conference many young people are "bored, desperate and lost".
